siniestros.querySql:
WITH vehiculos AS (
  SELECT
    vh.cpoliza,
    vh.ccerti,
    vh.xplaca,
    vh.ctipo,
    TRIM(vh.xsercar) AS xsercar,
    TRIM(vh.xsermot) AS xsermot,
    TRIM(vh.xcolor) AS xcolor,
    vh.qpuestos,
    inma.xmarca,
    inma.xmodelo,
    inma.xversion,
    vh.fanopol,
    vh.fmespol,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY vh.cpoliza, vh.ccerti, vh.fanopol, vh.fmespol
      ORDER BY vh.xplaca
    ) AS rn
  FROM vhcerti vh
  LEFT JOIN mavinma inma
    ON vh.cano = inma.qano
    AND vh.cmarca = inma.cmarca
    AND vh.cmodelo = inma.cmodelo
    AND vh.cversion = inma.cversion
)
SELECT
  CAST(s.cramo as int) as id_ramo,
  CAST(trim(r.xdescripcion_l) as varchar(30)) as c_ramo,
  CAST(trim(s.cnpoliza) as varchar(30)) as numero_poliza,
  CAST(trim(s.cnsinies) as varchar(30)) as numero_siniestro,
  CAST(trim(m1.cid) as varchar(30)) as cedula_asegurado,
  CAST(trim(m1.xcliente) as varchar(240)) as nombre_apellido_asegurado,
  CAST(vh.ccerti as int) certificado,
  CAST(vh.xplaca as varchar(30)) placa,
  CAST(NULLIF(RTRIM(tv.xtipo), '') AS varchar(60)) AS tipo_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xsercar as varchar(60)) serial_carroceria,
  CAST(vh.xsermot as varchar(60)) serial_motor,
  CAST(vh.xcolor as varchar(60)) color_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.qpuestos as int) numero_puestos,
  CAST(vh.xmarca as varchar(100)) marca_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xmodelo as varchar(100)) modelo_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xversion as varchar(100)) version_vehiculo,
  CAST(trim(m2.cid) as varchar(30)) as cedula_siniestrado,
  CAST(trim(m2.xcliente) as varchar(240)) as nombre_apellido_siniestrado,
  CAST(s.focursin as date) as fecha_ocurrencia,
  CAST(s.fnotifi as date) as fecha_notificacion,
  CAST(s.cmoneda as varchar(4)) as moneda,
  CAST(s.montosiniestro as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_siniestro_bs,
  CAST(s.montosiniestroext as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_siniestro_ext,
  CAST(s.mreserva as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_reserva_bs,
  CAST(s.mreservaext as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_reserva_ext,
  CAST(s.mpagos as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_pagado_bs,
  CAST(s.mpagosext as numeric(17, 4)) as monto_pagado_ext,
  CASE sm.imovsin
    WHEN 'CR' THEN 'Constitución de reserva'
    WHEN 'GA' THEN 'Pago de Gastos Administrativos'
    WHEN 'LR' THEN 'Liberación de reserva'
    WHEN 'PP' THEN 'Pago Parcial'
    WHEN 'PT' THEN 'Pago Total'
    WHEN 'RS' THEN 'Recuperación'
    ELSE sm.imovsin
  END AS tipo_movimiento,
  CAST(sm.csolpag as int) numero_orden_pago,
  CAST(ads.fsolicit as date) fecha_emision_orden,
  CAST(ads.fmovim as date) fecha_pago_orden,
  CASE s.istatsin
    WHEN 'P' THEN 2
    WHEN 'F' THEN 3
    WHEN 'A' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Z' THEN 5
    WHEN 'N' THEN 1
    ELSE NULL
  END AS id_estatus,
  CASE pe.itiposin
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'CARTA AVAL'
    WHEN 'E' THEN 'CLAVE DE EMERGENCIA'
    WHEN 'R' THEN 'REEMBOLSO'
    WHEN 'G' THEN 'GASTOS FUNERARIOS'
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'ATENCIÓN PRIMARIA DE SALUD'
    ELSE 'N/A'
  END AS tipo_siniestro,
  CAST(pr.cproductor as int) productor,
  CAST(ISNULL(mcan.ccanalalt, 0) AS int) AS id_canal,
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN p.ctipocanal IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE p.ctipocanal
          WHEN 'A' THEN 'Alterno'
          WHEN 'P' THEN 'Punto de venta'
          WHEN 'T' THEN 'Tradicional'
          WHEN 'D' THEN 'Directo'
          ELSE 'Otro'
        END
      WHEN TRY_CAST(RTRIM(p.ccanalalt) AS int) > 0
        AND COALESCE(p.cproductor, s.cproductor) = 80080 THEN 'Alterno'
      WHEN COALESCE(p.cproductor, s.cproductor) = 80080 THEN 'Directo'
      WHEN COALESCE(p.cproductor, s.cproductor) <> 80080 THEN 'Tradicional'
    END AS varchar(20)) AS tipo_canal,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cramo = 18 THEN CAST(pl.xplan AS varchar(100))
    ELSE CAST(plp.xplan AS varchar(100))
  END AS plan_poliza,
  CAST(p.csucurrec as int) as id_sucursal_receptora,
  CAST(trim(sp.xdescripcion_l) as varchar(100)) as sucursal_receptora,
  CASE WHEN an.canula BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN CAST(an.canula AS int) ELSE NULL END as id_anulacion,
  CAST(an.xanula as varchar(60)) as anulacion,
  CAST(an.fultmod as datetime) as fecha_anulacion,
  CASE WHEN mr.crechazo BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN CAST(mr.crechazo AS int) ELSE NULL END as id_rechazo,
  CAST(mr.xrechazo as varchar(60)) as rechazo,
  CAST(mr.fultmod as datetime) as fecha_rechazo,
  CAST(TRIM(tr.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS tipo_ramo,
  CAST(TRIM(cob.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS cobertura_afectada,
  sm.ptasamon AS tasa_cambio,
  COALESCE(s.fultmod, s.fnotifi, s.fingreso) as modified_at
FROM snsinies s
LEFT JOIN maramos r ON r.cramo = s.cramo
LEFT JOIN maclient m1 ON m1.cci_rif = s.casegurado
LEFT JOIN maclient m2 ON m2.cci_rif = s.csiniestrado
LEFT JOIN snmovsin sm ON sm.cnsinies = s.cnsinies AND sm.cmovsin = (SELECT TOP 1 inner_mov.cmovsin FROM snmovsin inner_mov WHERE inner_mov.cnsinies = s.cnsinies ORDER BY inner_mov.cmovsin DESC)
LEFT JOIN macoberturas cob ON cob.ccobertura = sm.ccober AND cob.cramo = sm.cramo
LEFT JOIN vehiculos vh ON vh.cpoliza = s.cpoliza AND vh.ccerti = s.ccerti AND vh.fanopol = s.fanopol AND vh.fmespol = s.fmespol AND vh.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN matipos tv ON tv.cramo = s.cramo AND tv.ctipo = vh.ctipo
LEFT JOIN adpoliza p ON s.cpoliza = p.cpoliza AND s.fanopol = p.fanopol AND s.fmespol = p.fmespol
LEFT JOIN macanalalt mcan ON mcan.ccanalalt = TRY_CAST(RTRIM(p.ccanalalt) AS SMALLINT)
LEFT JOIN masucur sp ON p.csucurrec = sp.csucur
LEFT JOIN matiporamo tr ON r.ctiporamo = tr.ctiporamo
LEFT JOIN pesinies pe ON s.csinies = pe.csinies
LEFT JOIN adsolpg ads ON ads.csolpag = sm.csolpag
LEFT JOIN maproduc pr ON pr.cproductor = s.cproductor
LEFT JOIN maplanes pl ON pl.cramo = s.cramo AND pl.cplan = p.cplan
LEFT JOIN maplanes_per plp ON plp.cramo = s.cramo AND plp.cplan = p.cplan
LEFT JOIN maanula an ON an.canula = s.canula
LEFT JOIN marechazo mr ON mr.crechazo = s.crechazo
WHERE (@poliza IS NULL OR s.cnpoliza = @poliza)
AND (@cnsinies IS NULL OR REPLACE(s.cnsinies, '-', '') = @cnsinies)
AND (@ramo IS NULL OR s.cramo = @ramo)
AND (@productor IS NULL OR pr.cproductor = @productor)
AND ((@desde IS NULL AND @hasta IS NULL) OR (CAST(/*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ AS date) BETWEEN COALESCE(@desde, '1900-01-01') AND COALESCE(@hasta, '2100-12-31')))
AND ((@fdesdeinc IS NULL AND @fhastainc IS NULL) OR (CAST(s.focursin AS date) BETWEEN COALESCE(@fdesdeinc, '1900-01-01') AND COALESCE(@fhastainc, '2100-12-31')))
AND ((@fdesdeestatus IS NULL AND @fhastaestatus IS NULL) OR (CAST(CASE WHEN @istatsin = '3' OR @istatsin = 'F' THEN ads.fmovim WHEN @istatsin = '4' OR @istatsin = 'A' THEN an.fultmod WHEN @istatsin = '5' OR @istatsin = 'Z' THEN mr.fultmod ELSE ads.fsolicit END AS date) BETWEEN COALESCE(@fdesdeestatus, '1900-01-01') AND COALESCE(@fhastaestatus, '2100-12-31')))
AND (@casegurado IS NULL OR REPLACE(TRIM(m1.cid), '-', '') = @casegurado)
AND (@csinies IS NULL OR REPLACE(TRIM(m2.cid), '-', '') = @csinies)
AND (@moneda IS NULL OR s.cmoneda = @moneda)
AND (@istatsin IS NULL OR
  s.istatsin = @istatsin OR
  CASE s.istatsin
    WHEN 'P' THEN '2'
    WHEN 'F' THEN '3'
    WHEN 'A' THEN '4'
    WHEN 'Z' THEN '5'
    WHEN 'N' THEN '1'
    ELSE s.istatsin
  END = @istatsin
)
/*SYNC_WHERE*/
/*SYNC_ORDER BY*/
